products.title: No Poo Eating 🌿 100% natural 🫙 60 soft chews
products.body_html:
The No Poo Eating chews are specially developed for dogs who:

  • Eat their own or other dogs’ poos

  • Suffer from unpleasant breath

  • Experience discomfort after eating or have a sensitive stomach

These tasty chews reduce unwanted eating behaviour naturally. The ingredients make poos less appealing in both smell and taste – even those from other dogs. As a result, your dog begins to break the association between poos and a “reward” (taste/smell), which helps to stop the behaviour. At the same time, this supplement supports a healthy gut flora.

Many owners notice a clear improvement in behaviour and digestion within just a few weeks. Developed by passionate nutritionists with over 10 years of experience in pet supplements.

Order now and help your dog overcome this habit safely and naturally – with free shipping and a 60-day money-back guarantee on your first order.
